description: This file defines the AdminUserAPI class, which provides REST API endpoints for handling admin user data during installation of OrangeHRM. It handles GET and POST requests to manage administrator account details, utilizing internal state management and validation methods.

classes.name: AdminUserAPI
classes.description: REST API controller for managing admin user data during installation, providing endpoints to retrieve and submit admin user details.

methods.name: handlePost
methods.description: Handles POST requests to store admin user data, validating required fields and storing data in the state container.

methods.name: checkAndGetField
methods.description: Validates presence and retrieves a specific field from the request, throwing an exception if missing.

methods.name: handleGet
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve stored admin user data from the state container.
